reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount and replaces the five inline midpoint copies with calls to it.

duplication.why: Removes every duplicated midpoint/missing-amount dispatch; no new copy is added.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, already used by the desktop client, and server consumers call it.

scope.why: Only the rule, its consumers, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule is now a single edit in one well-commented function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server and client consumers go through getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, used by schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the desktop-client callers.
